stories.title: Most precise measurement of coherent elastic neutrino–nucleus scattering to date tightens limits on new forces
stories.desc: Neutrinos are tiny elementary particles with little mass and no electric charge. While most neutrinos pass through matter without interacting, a neutrino can occasionally scatter off an atomic nucleus, transferring a little energy to it and causing it to move.
